description: Takes a won prize's SOL instead of the prize now, as the prizes page does, through the site's own route for that kind of prize: its share of the prize's worth (my_wins solOffer: 75% for a skin or a case, 66% for most others, 60% for a store's piece), or an xStocks prize's full worth. Paid to your wallet within minutes. Final: the prize can't be claimed after. Only while the win waits for you and only where the site offers it; hold to claim applies (your wallet must still hold 90% of the coins that counted for the win). Answers { ok } (and bps, the share). Takes the token from sign_in (sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with the wallet, sign_in), as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header. Refused with "Wins through the API are not open yet." while they are not open to your wallet, as launching is.

country.description: Where you are, optional (a physical item: it shows Souvenir where to ship next).

mint.description: The coin the prize was won on (a win's mint in my_wins).

round.description: The round it was won in (a win's number in my_wins).

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

name: claim_sol
title: Take a win's SOL instead
